caption: t-SNE of 292 confirmed orca_call embeddings (Perch V2, cosine) from April 2018, colored by confirmed day: Apr 13 (n=214), Apr 18 (n=28), Apr 25 (n=50). Apr 25 forms a distinct cluster separated from the Apr 13 event WITHIN the same month (background/SNR confound controlled); Apr 18 shows partial/arc structure; Apr 13 is the diffuse bulk. Exploratory (t-SNE distances not meaningful); suggests Apr 25 may be a different pod/individual/call-type. Finding #14 follow-up.
notes: Confirmed-orca days only (filename-date filter). Caveat: same-month separation still needs within-day confound ruled out (ship-noise/single-recording). Pending perplexity sweep + distinct-recording check. Expert: D. Edgington.
